title: Reserve capacity is not spare capacity for every purpose
method: Synthetic 200-unit estate: 120+30+20+30=200. New demand of 45 exceeds unallocated headroom by 15; reserving capacity serves explicit maintenance and growth assumptions.
alt: Reserve capacity is not spare capacity for every purpose: Normal demand 120 workload units, Maintenance reserve 30 workload units, Growth allowance 20 workload units, Unallocated 30 workload units. Illustrative inputs.
